The company offers AI-powered travel, payments, and expense management solutions to streamline the travel lifecycle, from booking and policy enforcement to payment processing, expense reconciliation, and reporting. It serves finance, human resources, travel managers, inventory, and other markets. It has partnership with OpenTable Partner for AI-Powered Business Travel Planning.
